title: Optima Health v Secretary of State for Work and Pensions
description: DWP excluded Optima's bid due to minor clerical errors in pricing schedule exceeding framework prices. The High Court upheld the exclusion, but the Court of Appeal reversed, holding that DWP should have sought clarification before treating the bid as non-compliant. The Court of Appeal found that Optima was the highest-scoring bidder on quality and should have been awarded the contract.
bidder_name: Working on Wellbeing Ltd (t/a Optima Health)
